webspark_target.depends_on_note: None. The heading swash is not a shared SDC include: copy the .scrib-host / .scrib / .scrib--myours rules from underline-mark into homepage-make-it-yours.css (design doc section 23), and serve img/scribble-myours.svg from the module.
webspark_target.css_source: dist/css/components-homepage.css rules for .hp-myours* plus .scrib-host / .scrib / .scrib--myours (underline-mark), copied as plain CSS; no SCSS and no Laravel Mix at Stage B. The --hp-focus-inner / --hp-focus-outer custom properties it reads must be defined in the same file or by the host.
webspark_target.js_flavor: plain ES2017 Drupal.behaviors port of make-it-yours.js. MUST: set inert on closed panels; swap img alt (data-alt-desktop vs data-alt-mobile) at the 769px matchMedia; set both reserve properties (--hp-myours-tabs-min on .hp-myours__tabs and --hp-myours-caption-min on .hp-myours) on stacked layouts only; coalesce measure() through requestAnimationFrame; tear down in Drupal.behaviors.<name>.detach (window click/resize listeners, resize observer, pending frame; keep the teardown per section, e.g. in a WeakMap).

webspark_target.limits_note: Limits are MAKE_IT_YOURS_LIMITS in make-it-yours-markup.js (amendment A2.1), measured with every field at its limit at 769, 1280 and 3934px: the tallest open tab ends 26px above the 865px stage bottom, titles and CTAs stay on one line. The markup helper does not enforce them; Stage B validates. The stacked layout grows with content and needs no extra limit.

validation.tab_count: exactly five tabs (min 5, max 5); message 'Make it yours needs exactly five tabs.'
validation.required: every field above is required except focal point (defaults to 50% 50%)
validation.underlined: must be a suffix of the heading
validation.cta_url: accept only http(s)://, root-relative '/x' (not starting '//' or '/\'), or '#fragment'. REJECT any value containing a C0 control character (U+0000-U+001F) or DEL (U+007F); do not strip, because browsers strip tab/LF/CR and '/<tab>/host' would become a protocol-relative link. Any other scheme (javascript:, data:, mailto: and so on) is invalid.

desktop: mit_1280: scale to >=1280 wide AND >=865 tall
mit_1920: scale to >=1920 wide AND >=865 tall
mit_2560: scale to >=2560 wide AND >=865 tall
image_variants.desktop_rule: Each style scales to at least the tier width AND at least 865px tall (the stage height), so a wide, short photo gets a wider file (Unity: tabs 1 and 2 mit_1280 is 1330 wide, tab 4 is 1873 wide). The srcset descriptor MUST be the real output width of each file, not the nominal tier.
image_variants.img_attributes: mobile crop is the , width=900 height=650, loading=lazy, decoding=async; alt is the mobile alt, data-alt-desktop carries the desktop alt

webspark_target.template_data: the section 7 data object: heading, underlined, intro, tabs[5]{slug,title,description,cta{label,url},desktop{sources[{src,width}],alt,caption,focus},mobile{src,alt,caption}}; the Twig output must equal markup.html after whitespace normalization (id prefix is the only per-copy variable)
webspark_target.scribble_asset: img/scribble-myours.svg must be served by the module (not part of dist/img/make-it-yours)

interactivity.summary: WAI-ARIA APG Accordion, single open, one panel always open. Static markup is full HTML (all panels open, photo 1); JS applies state; CSS toggles by class. With JS off, every panel is open and only photo 1 shows (readable baseline).

state_machine.desc: tab i open; initial i=0 at every width; no none-state; no preview state; no hover preview

activation.desktop: click, Enter or Space on a closed header opens it; no hover preview
activation.initial: tab 1 (Design your degree) at every width
activation.open_header: aria-disabled=true; click, Enter and Space are no-ops, stopped in the capture phase (preventDefault + stopPropagation) so a document-level GA listener never sees them
activation.commit: the state change is deferred by one task (0ms timer) so document-level click readers still see the old state during the click

keys.Tab/Shift+Tab: visits all five headers and the open panel's CTA
keys.ArrowDown/ArrowUp: move focus to next/previous header (wraps), focus only, never opens
keys.Home/End: focus first/last header, focus only, never opens

keyboard.focus: no roving tabindex; focus stays on the activated header; 44px touch targets; visible focus ring from --hp-focus-inner / --hp-focus-outer

aria.roles: h3 > button.hp-myours__trigger; panel is role=region with aria-labelledby=trigger; no live region
aria.dynamic: aria-expanded true/false on every trigger and aria-disabled=true on the open trigger (added by JS, absent in static markup); closed panels get inert (JS) plus visibility hidden (CSS fallback); img alt is swapped to data-alt-desktop from 769px and back to data-alt-mobile at 768px and below

class_toggles.effect: CSS switches from the all-open baseline to the accordion
panel grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, bar fills, title white
that photo displayed, others display:none, instant (static markup has it on photo 1)
list min-height reserves the tallest open state; stacked only
caption min-height reserves the tallest caption so the whole section has one height for all five tabs (+-1px); removed on desktop and on teardown; re-measured on resize and document.fonts.ready
that photo's image is promoted so the switch rarely waits

css_variables.--hp-myours-tabs-min: see above; JS-set, stacked only. Do not set in the CMS.
css_variables.--hp-myours-caption-min: see above; JS-set, stacked only. Do not set in the CMS.
css_variables.--hp-myours-focus: static, inline on each figure from the focal point field; desktop object-position

interactivity.alt_swap: in the static markup is the mobile alt; JS stores it as data-alt-mobile and sets alt from matchMedia('(min-width: 769px)') on boot and on change. Captions carry both texts in two spans switched by CSS (no JS).
interactivity.motion: panel 0.5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), bar 0.5s, title color 0.35s; all inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; none under reduce; photo switch is instant (no crossfade or zoom)
interactivity.reduced_motion: all transitions are declared only inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); under reduce the state change is instant
interactivity.forced_colors: opaque Canvas panels, CanvasText text, Highlight open bar, arrow uses currentColor, scrim hidden

breakpoints.stacked: <= 768px: white centered head, inset 900x650 photo, dark band with the tab list (min-height = tallest open state via --hp-myours-tabs-min), caption reserve via --hp-myours-caption-min; the heading swash sits under 'yours' only
breakpoints.side_by_side: >= 769px: full-bleed photo with per-photo object-position in a fixed 865px stage (frame 1920), 548px content column on the right over a shared scrim, caption chip
breakpoints.notes: 769 is one pixel off the UDS md breakpoint on purpose; the SCSS ($hp-myours-bp), make-it-yours.js and <source media> all use (min-width: 769px)

interactivity.no_js_baseline: every panel open, photo 1 only, mobile alt on the image (known limit R2 on desktop); captions unaffected. Section can be taller than 865px on desktop without JS.

analytics.when: on opening a closed header (event select, action open) and on CTA click (event link, action click) only; clicking the open header is not an event
analytics.mechanism: data-ga-* attributes on every trigger and CTA, read by the asucms data layer

values.name: onclick
values.type: internal link or external link by host (SSR falls back to www.asu.edu, so all CTAs are external link)

analytics.guards: open-header click stopped in the capture phase; state committed after document-level readers (deferred one task)
